title: Further Help by ASEAN to Resolve Situation in Rakhine State
what_it_is: Further Help by ASEAN to Resolve Situation in Rakhine State

sections.label: Myanmar inquiry and refugee return
sections.summary: Foreign Ministers urged Myanmar's Independent Commission of Inquiry be fully mandated and called on Myanmar and Bangladesh to enable voluntary refugee return, which has not occurred.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The Foreign Ministers urged the Myanmar government that since the Myanmar government has appointed an Independent Commission of Inquiry, that this Independent Commission of Inquiry should be given a full mandate to investigate, and to hold all those responsible fully accountable.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: We also called on both Myanmar and Bangladesh which have, in fact, signed an agreement in November last year that they should provide for the voluntary, safe and dignified return of refugees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: But to date, not a single refugee has returned under the aegis of that agreement.

sections.label: Singapore assistance and Myanmar responsibility
sections.summary: Singapore's private and people sector organisations are sending assistance to Bangladesh, while responsibility for resolving the situation lies with Myanmar's government.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: In the meantime, I know that the private sector and people sector organisations within Singapore are also sending appropriate assistance to Bangladesh.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: I want to emphasise that, ultimately, the responsibility for resolving this must lie with the government of Myanmar; and this is a responsibility that we will hold them to account.

sections.label: Myanmar rejects decisions
sections.summary: The Myanmar government does not recognise or accept the decisions, particularly regarding this situation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The unfortunate fact is that the Myanmar government does not recognise or accept the decisions, in particular, with respect to this particular situation.

sections.label: Practical approach to Myanmar inquiry
sections.summary: The approach is practical, focusing on the fact that Myanmar itself appointed an Independent Commission of Inquiry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: My approach to this is to be practical.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: That is why we focus on the fact that Myanmar herself has appointed an Independent Commission of Inquiry.

sections.label: Humanitarian assistance commitments at UN
sections.summary: At last week's UN meeting and side meetings, various countries including the US made commitments for additional humanitarian assistance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Again, at the UN meeting last week – in fact, there were several side meetings as well – my sense is that there are commitments for additional humanitarian assistance by various countries, including, as the Member quite rightly said, the US.

sections.label: ASEAN expects voluntary repatriation
sections.summary: ASEAN told Myanmar it expects voluntary repatriation to begin soon and stands ready to help facilitate it.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Specifically, what we said last week to Myanmar was that we expect the voluntary repatriation to begin soon, and ASEAN stands ready to help to facilitate that in any way possible.

sections.label: Fundraising over a million dollars
sections.summary: The Member may be aware that fundraising has occurred, with more than a million dollars given.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: But I think the Member may be aware that there has been fundraising.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: I think more than a million dollars have been given.

sections.label: Humanitarian aid and political solution
sections.summary: The passage calls for short-term humanitarian assistance and a longer-term political solution, noting the problem has existed about 200 years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Third, address humanitarian assistance in the short term.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: And fourth, try to promote a longer-term political solution.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: But again, for Members who go back in history, this problem has been there probably for about 200 years.
